recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tamil Nadu**'s **Attorney General**, Vijay Narayan, informed the Madras High Court that the government is prioritizing the safety of women and children by developing an action plan to prevent and prosecute sexual crimes against them.  He acknowledged delays in trial completion for such offenses but assured the court that measures are being taken to strengthen police forces and ensure swift justice. The **Attorney General** stated that a detailed plan would take two to three weeks to develop, including establishing more forensic laboratories. The court issued an interim order directing the Mahila Court in Tiruvannamalai to complete the trial of the PIL petitioner by July 31, 2026.

recent_articles.title: German ex-Red Army Faction militant Daniela Klette jailed for armed robberies after years on the run
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A former member of the German militant group Red Army Faction (RAF), **Daniela Klette**, was sentenced to 13 years in prison for her involvement in a series of armed robberies between 1999 and 2016.  **Klette**, who had been on the run for over 30 years, was finally apprehended in Berlin in 2024 after a tip-off to police. Prosecutors allege that **Klette** was complicit in three of the group's attacks, including a failed bombing at a Deutsche Bank building and a prison bombing.  The trial focused on eight robberies across northern and western Germany, with **Klette** not explicitly admitting to being an RAF member during the trial but facing further charges related to her alleged involvement in the group's activities.

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma death: Madhya Pradesh DGP defends Bhopal Police as CBI takes over case, launches probe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Madhya Pradesh** Director General of Police (DGP) Kailash Makwana stated that the **Bhopal Police** followed established procedures in the Twisha Sharma death case, which was subsequently taken over by the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**.  The family has alleged institutional bias and procedural lapses by local police, including accusations against retired district judge Giribala Singh, who is an accused in the dowry death and harassment case. The CBI team visited Ms. Singh's residence and questioned her while also meeting with the victim’s family members. The **High Court** will hear petitions challenging Ms. Singh’s anticipatory bail on May 27th.

recent_articles.title: Fast-track court frames charges against seven accused in Zubeen Garg death case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Zubeen Garg**, the renowned cultural icon, was found dead in Singapore in September 2025. **Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma** stated that Garg’s death was a result of a conspiracy, while a Singapore coroner's inquiry concluded it was an accidental drowning.  A special fast-track court on Tuesday (May 26, 2026) framed charges against seven accused, including **Shyamkanu Mahanta**, the event organizer, and **Siddharth Sharma**, Garg’s manager, for murder. The trial is scheduled to begin on June 8th.

recent_articles.title: Jury seated as US trial of Catholic priest accused of sexual assault begins | Texas | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A jury of eight women and four men was selected for the criminal trial of **Anthony Odiong**, a Roman Catholic priest, who is charged with sexually assaulting three women in Waco, Texas.  Odiong faces five counts of first-degree sexual assault and two counts of second-degree sexual assault. The charges stem from allegations made by several women who accused him of exploiting their emotional dependency for sexual purposes while he was ministering in Texas and Louisiana. Prosecutors will present evidence that Odiong violated the Catholic promise of celibacy, fathered a child with a congregant, and engaged in inappropriate financial control over his accusers.  Odiong's lawyers argue that the state waited too long to file charges against him, introducing hearsay testimony about the number of accusers. The trial is expected to last into next week.

recent_articles.title: 'Unjust and unfounded': Mango founder's son denies killing father, steps down as vice president - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jonathan Andic**, son of late Mango founder **Isak Andic**, has stepped down as vice president of the fashion giant's board to focus on his legal defense after being arrested in Spain as part of an investigation into his father's death.  **Andic** denies any involvement in his father's death, calling the accusations "serious, unjust and unfounded." The case was reopened in October 2025 after investigators found inconsistencies in **Andic**'s statements and the circumstances surrounding the fall. Authorities are also investigating potential tensions between the father and son related to Isak Andic's plans for a charitable foundation.

recent_articles.title: Woman shot dead outside Sheffield bar was innocent bystander, police say | UK news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **South Yorkshire police** are investigating the fatal shooting of a 30-year-old woman outside a Sheffield bar. The victim, an innocent bystander celebrating the bank holiday weekend, was found with serious injuries and later died in hospital. **Ch Supt Jamie Henderson**, district commander for Sheffield, stated that two men and a woman have been arrested on suspicion of murder, while police are appealing for witnesses who were in the area around 2:45 am Monday morning.

recent_articles.title: Indian-origin woman killed at supermarket in Virginia; shooter had no connection with her, was later found dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 45-year-old Indian woman, **Meghnaben Patel**, was fatally shot at a convenience store in Virginia on May 23rd. Surveillance footage shows the attacker approaching the counter where she worked and shooting her multiple times before fleeing.  The shooter died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound after being found by police who were responding to reports of a domestic dispute that occurred earlier. Police have not identified any additional suspects in connection with the incident.
